chapters.title: Manual process at Interfrucht: 20 minutes per manifest

features.name: Manifest Agent for Business Central
features.description: An agent that monitors a shared mailbox, automatically reads manifest PDFs, extracts data, validates it, and creates purchase orders in Business Central without manual intervention.
caveats: Runs every 5 minutes via job queue

features.name: Automated purchase order creation from manifests
features.description: The agent automatically creates purchase orders in Business Central with correct vendor, items, quantities, and locations extracted from manifest documents.
caveats: Data validation required before purchase order creation

features.name: Mailbox monitoring and document processing
features.description: The agent continuously monitors a shared mailbox, detects incoming manifest PDFs, reads the documents, and automatically extracts relevant data.

features.name: Job queue execution with audit logging
features.description: The agent runs securely through a job queue every 5 minutes, logging each step and ensuring every action is traceable for compliance and troubleshooting.
caveats: 5-minute execution interval may not be suitable for extremely time-sensitive operations

quotes.text: Someone had to open the email, download the attachment, read the document, verify the information, and manually create purchase orders in Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the manual workflow that existed before automation, establishing the pain point the agent solves.

quotes.text: Each manifest took 20 minutes to process, and this happened up to 10 times a day.
quotes.why_it_matters: Quantifies the time cost and volume of the manual process, demonstrating significant operational impact.

quotes.why_it_matters: States the core capability of the Manifest Agent and how it operates without manual intervention.

quotes.text: creates the purchase orders in Business Central. The right vendor, the right items, the right quantities, and locations.
quotes.why_it_matters: Specifies what data the agent correctly captures and populates when creating purchase orders.

quotes.text: The agent runs securely through a job queue every 5 minutes, ensuring manifests are processed quickly and consistently.

quotes.text: What once took up to 20 minutes now happens in minutes, accurately, reliably, and automatically.
quotes.why_it_matters: Quantifies the time improvement achieved by the automation solution.
